heroes.name: Seraphiel
heroes.title: the Choir Eternal
heroes.bio: The last seraph who still sings the hymn that once held the sky together. Every note is a sunrise; every chorus, a judgment.
heroes.look: Statuesque, voluptuous pop goddess of heaven: six pearl-white wings with aqua tips, a large chrome halo ring, very long platinum hair. Pearl-white liquid-latex sling leotard plunging to the navel and open at the sides, pearl-vinyl stage drapes from chrome hip rings, chrome body chains, mirror-chrome platform heels. Raises a chrome tuning-fork microphone stand like a torch; eyes closed, a knowing half-smile.

ultimate.name: Hymn of Judgment
ultimate.description: Sings the sky's final verse: 180% ATK to all enemies and Stuns them for 1.5 s.

passives.name: Radiant Aria
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to Stun the target for 1 s.

passives.name: Choir Eternal
passives.description: +20% ATK and +10% HP.

legend.title: Herald of the Last Hymn

passive.name: Last Hymn
passive.description: +25% ATK, +15% crit chance and +40% crit damage. Battle start: gains 400 energy.

ult_bonus.name: Hymn of Judgment: Encore
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also Weakens every enemy (-25% ATK for 5 s) and shields all allies for 10% of her max HP.

lore: The hymn has one more verse. She has never sung it in front of anyone who lived.
Heaven keeps a recording of her first sunrise. The tape is played once a millennium, quietly.
When the sky finally falls, she means to be the last thing it hears.

heroes.name: Cassiel
heroes.title: Aegis of Dawn
heroes.bio: Captain of the Gate Wardens. She has never taken a step backward, and she does not intend to start.
heroes.look: Athletic, curvy aero paladin: glossy white console-robot micro armor with small plate cups and aqua seams, oversized white-and-chrome pauldrons, gauntlets, bare midriff, thong-cut plate bottom, white mecha thigh greaves. A tall frosted aqua riot-glass kite shield planted at her side, hand on hip. Short silver bob, chrome visor tiara, white wings, chrome halo; a cocky smirk.

ultimate.name: Dawnwall
ultimate.description: Raises the Gate Wardens' wall: shields all allies for 10% of her max HP and grants them +20% DEF for 5 s.

passives.name: Unbroken Line
passives.description: +15% HP and +10% DEF.

passives.name: Morning Vigil
passives.description: Battle start: gains a shield equal to 25% of her max HP.

heroes.name: Liora
heroes.title: Hymn of Mending
heroes.bio: A temple novice whose lullabies close wounds. She is still learning which songs are safe to sing in battle.
heroes.look: Soft, curvy spa goddess with glam makeup: white string bikini strung with pearl chains, a pearl satin sarong at the hip, chrome anklets and heels, water droplets on her skin. Long rose-gold hair in a wet-look side braid, a frosted aqua glass lyre, pearl wings, a slim chrome halo. Stands with her hip cocked and the lyre at her side, a slow, warm smile.

ultimate.name: Lullaby of Mending
ultimate.description: A lullaby that closes wounds: heals all allies for 240% ATK and grants Regen (40% ATK per second) for 4 s.

passives.name: Soft Refrain
passives.description: Healing done +25%.

passives.name: Hymn of Plenty
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain +10% max HP.

heroes.name: Uriela
heroes.title: the Sunlance
heroes.bio: A spear maiden of the outer bastions, eager to prove the old stories about her namesake true.
heroes.look: Toned, curvy sky racer: glossy azure-and-white racing leotard, highleg and thong-cut, with an underboob cutout and a navel window, sun-sigil decals, racing gloves, white platform racing boots. A chrome shield visor pushed up into a high honey-blonde ponytail; a chrome aero lance with a frosted aqua blade over her shoulder; pearl wings, thin chrome halo; a confident grin.

ultimate.name: Sunlance
ultimate.description: Hurls her blazing spear: 360% ATK to her target and breaks its armor, -40% DEF for 6 s.

passives.name: Sunburst Edge
passives.description: +15% crit chance and +25% crit damage.

heroes.name: Nuriel
heroes.title: the Lens Flare
heroes.bio: Heaven's fastest courier, until she started delivering knives. You see the flash on her visor; you never see her.
heroes.look: Lean, long-legged courier-assassin: aqua-chrome zip-front sport bandeau, glossy white thong-back sport brief, cropped white vinyl track jacket slipping off her shoulders, chrome thigh holsters, racing gloves, white platform trainers with bubble air soles. Mirrored chrome shield visor, platinum pixie cut with aqua tips, four jet-fin pearl wings, a thin chrome halo. Twin crystal daggers, one in reverse grip; a cool half-smile.

ultimate.name: Daybreak Ambush
ultimate.description: Dives to the back row: strikes the weakest back-row enemy twice for 170% ATK each and Stuns it for 1 s.

passives.name: First Light
passives.description: Battle start: gains 400 energy.

heroes.name: Argentiel
heroes.title: the Sky Marshal
heroes.bio: Commander of heaven's sky legions and the only angel who has never lost a duel. Her armor is living chrome, and she tops it up from a hip flask the way other women reapply lipstick.
heroes.look: Statuesque, athletic sky marshal with deep brown skin: liquid-chrome micro armor that looks still molten, two small mirror-chrome cups and a highleg, thong-cut chrome bottom joined by chrome rivulets over bare skin, a bare midriff and back, chrome thigh-high greaves. Long black box braids in a high crown with chrome cuffs, mirror-chrome lips, a broad chrome halo, four swept-back pearl wings with aqua tips. A huge double-bladed chrome glaive across her shoulders with both wrists draped over it, feet planted wide, chin up.

ultimate.name: Mercury Verdict
ultimate.description: Sweeps the liquid-chrome glaive twice through the front row: 2 hits of 150% ATK to every front-row enemy, -30% DEF on them for 6 s, and +25% ATK for herself for 6 s.

passives.name: Living Chrome
passives.description: Takes 10% less damage and gains +10% ATK.

passives.name: Never Lost a Duel
passives.description: +40% crit damage. On kill: gains 300 energy.

legend.title: Quicksilver Sovereign

passive.name: Quicksilver Oath
passive.description: +20% ATK and +15% DEF. Takes 15% less damage. Each basic attack has a 30% chance to strike twice.

ult_bonus.name: Mercury Verdict: Final Ruling
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also hits every back-row enemy for 160% ATK and gives her +30% SPD for 6 s.

lore: Four hundred duels, four hundred wins. She keeps the losers' halos in a drawer, polished.
The flask is not chrome. It is the first legion, melted down and carried with her.
She has requested a duel with heaven's throne itself. The paperwork is still pending.

heroes.name: Sanariel
heroes.title: Mercy Ward
heroes.bio: Matron of heaven's infirmary. She has stitched up every angel in the legions and scolded every one of them while she did it.
heroes.look: Soft, voluptuous cyber nurse: a skin-tight white PVC nurse minidress zipped open to the navel on one chrome ring, hip-high side slits over white latex garter straps and opaque highleg briefs, short puffed sleeves, white latex opera gloves and thigh-highs. A chrome nurse cap with an aqua plus sign, a chrome stethoscope, mirrored aqua lip gloss, long wavy mint-aqua hair in a loose low bun, large pearl wings folded like a cape, a slim chrome halo. A giant chrome syringe staff planted beside her, the stethoscope lifted to her lips; a patient, teasing smile.

ultimate.name: Code White
ultimate.description: Calls a Code White: heals all allies for 200% ATK, then heals the most wounded ally for another 250% ATK and shields her for 12% of Sanariel's max HP.

passives.name: Bedside Manner
passives.description: Healing done +15% and +10% HP.

passives.name: Night Rounds
passives.description: Each basic attack also heals the most wounded ally for 30% ATK. Battle start: all allies gain +5% max HP.

legend.title: Saint of the Night Shift

passive.name: Miracle Shift
passive.description: Healing done +30%. Battle start: all allies gain +10% max HP and +8% ATK, and she shields herself for 25% of her max HP.

ult_bonus.name: Code White: All Hands
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also gives all allies Regen (60% ATK per second) for 5 s and every other ally 150 energy.

lore: Her chart notes are signed in gold thread. No angel has died on her ward. Several have tried.
She once stitched a seraph's wing back on mid-flight and billed him for the thread.
The infirmary never closes. Neither, it turns out, do her eyes.

heroes.name: Rimelle
heroes.title: Triple Axel
heroes.bio: Heaven's reigning skating champion treats every battlefield as a rink and every enemy as a judge. So far, the judges have all frozen.
heroes.look: Long-legged champion skater with glam makeup: a rhinestone-crusted pearl holographic skating leotard, extreme highleg and thong-cut, plunging to the navel, open-backed to the hips, one long sleeve, with a short pearl-vinyl skirt open at the front; chrome blade skates. Long straight icy-lavender hair loose to her waist, icy holographic eyeshadow, a thin chrome halo, frosted pearl wings with solid icicle tips. One arm swept high with a frosted ice-crystal scepter, the other hand on her hip; a cool, cut-glass smile.

ultimate.name: Frozen Finale
ultimate.description: Lands her finale: 140% ATK to all enemies, Stuns the front row for 1 s and Weakens all enemies (-15% ATK) for 4 s.

passives.name: Rinkside Poise
passives.description: +12% ATK and +8% SPD.

passives.name: Deep Freeze
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 15% chance to Stun the target for 1 s.

heroes.name: Avienne
heroes.title: Cabin Chief
heroes.bio: Chief purser of heaven's flagship. She has kept every passenger alive through every kind of turbulence, and her smile has never once cracked.
heroes.look: Tall, hourglass chief purser of heaven's airline: a plunging white latex bodysuit with an underboob cutout, extreme highleg and thong-cut, under a cropped aqua PVC flight-attendant jacket worn open; white latex thigh-highs, white patent platform pumps. A chrome pillbox hat on a chestnut French twist, a knotted aqua scarf, a chrome flight-wings badge, white wings with aqua livery stripes, a chrome halo. A tall shield cut from a chrome aircraft wing planted at her side, her free hand pointing politely toward the exits; a flawless professional smile.

ultimate.name: Brace Position
ultimate.description: Brace for impact: shields all allies for 8% of her max HP, and every other ally gains 100 energy.

passives.name: Cabin Pressure
passives.description: +12% HP, and takes 5% less damage.

passives.name: Complimentary Service
passives.description: Each basic attack also heals the most wounded ally for 20% ATK.

heroes.name: Cirella
heroes.title: Perfect Ten
heroes.bio: Heaven's gold-medal gymnast, until someone sharpened her hoops. Now she sticks every landing on the enemy's back line.
heroes.look: Lithe, flexible gymnast with glam makeup: a metallic sky-blue racerback leotard, extreme highleg and thong-cut, with a diamond cutout from sternum to navel, both sides cut open from ribs to hips and a bare back; mirrored chrome arm bands, chrome ankle cuffs, barefoot. Cobalt-blue hair in a tight high ballet bun, two slim pearl wings swept up, a thin chrome halo. One bladed chrome hoop raised overhead framing her face, the other resting at her hip, up on the balls of her feet; a sunny, flirty smile.

ultimate.name: Ring of Blades
ultimate.description: Throws both bladed hoops through the back row: 2 hits of 100% ATK to every back-row enemy, then +20% SPD for 4 s.

passives.name: Perfect Form
passives.description: +15% crit chance and +8% SPD.

passives.name: Stick the Landing
passives.description: On kill: gains 400 energy and restores 10% of her max HP.

heroes.name: Ferrael
heroes.title: Halo Smith
heroes.bio: She forges every halo in heaven, and the dents in the big ones are hers. She settles arguments with a hammer and apologizes with a hug.
heroes.look: Strong, broad-shouldered, freckled smith: a heavy white PVC blacksmith's apron over a white micro bikini, open at the sides and back, bib straps crossed over her shoulders, cut short at mid-thigh; chrome-plated forge gauntlets, a chrome chain belt hung with freshly forged halos, white platform work boots. Chrome welding goggles pushed up into a short copper-red shag, soot-smudged pearl wings tucked tight, a chunky chrome halo she forged herself. A huge chrome forge hammer resting head-down by her boot, wiping her brow with one forearm; a big satisfied grin.

ultimate.name: Hammerfall
ultimate.description: Brings the forge hammer down: 300% ATK to her target and Stuns it for 2 s.

passives.name: Forge Hardened
passives.description: +10% ATK and +12% DEF.

passives.name: Sparks Fly
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to Expose the target: -20% DEF for 3 s.

heroes.name: Verdelle
heroes.title: Glasshouse Keeper
heroes.bio: Keeper of the sunlit glasshouse where every plant in creation grows. She is sure the war would end if everyone ate more vegetables.
heroes.look: Soft, curvy glasshouse keeper with glam makeup: a lime-green metallic halter monokini, highleg and thong-cut, plunging to the navel, with wide cutouts at both sides of the waist; a chrome tool belt slung on her hips, white platform rain boots. A wide-brim white vinyl sun hat, leaf-shaped chrome hair pins, long wavy strawberry-blonde hair with lime-green tips, pearl wings with lime tips, a chrome halo etched with leaves. A chrome teardrop watering can on her hip, her other hand pushing back her hat; a warm, chatty smile.

ultimate.name: Greenhouse Effect
ultimate.description: Turns up the glasshouse warmth: all allies gain Regen (50% ATK per second) for 6 s, and the most wounded ally heals for 200% ATK.

passives.name: Green Thumb
passives.description: Healing done +20%.

passives.name: Deep Roots
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain +8% max HP, and she gains a shield of 15% of her max HP.

heroes.name: Isobel
heroes.title: Storm Chaser
heroes.bio: She chases storms across heaven for fun and calls them down on enemies for work. She is happiest when the sky turns green.
heroes.look: Tall, toned storm chaser: a cropped white vinyl windbreaker covered in weather-icon decals, unzipped and blowing open over a sky-blue metallic micro bikini with small opaque cups and a highleg, thong-cut bottom; chrome carabiner straps across her hips, white platform hiking boots. A wind-tossed indigo bob with one white streak, storm-grey pearl wings with aqua tips, a chrome halo. A tall chrome anemometer staff raised into the wind, her other hand shading her eyes as she watches the sky; a breathless, thrilled grin.

ultimate.name: Wall Cloud
ultimate.description: Calls down the storm: 4 lightning strikes of 120% ATK at random enemies, then -20% DEF on all enemies for 4 s.

passives.name: Eye of the Storm
passives.description: +12% crit chance and +30% crit damage.

heroes.name: Halcia
heroes.title: Drop Zone
heroes.bio: She jumps out of heaven at forty thousand feet and opens her wings at the last possible second, usually right on top of someone's healer.
heroes.look: Athletic, sun-tanned skydiver: a white-and-aqua jumpsuit stripped off and knotted around her hips by the sleeves over an opaque aqua highleg sport bottom, an aqua sport micro top with an underboob cutout, chrome parachute-harness straps framing her chest and thighs, a chrome altimeter on her wrist, white jump boots. A wind-tousled sandy-blonde lob, four narrow pearl wings folded flat against her parachute pack, a thin chrome halo. A chrome katar in each fist in a wide, low stance; a fearless grin.

ultimate.name: Terminal Velocity
ultimate.description: Dives from forty thousand feet onto the weakest back-row enemy: 340% ATK, +60% damage if it is below 50% HP.

passives.name: Free Fall
passives.description: Battle start: gains 300 energy.

passives.name: Wingsuit
passives.description: +20% damage to enemies below 50% HP and +10% SPD.

heroes.name: Mordessa
heroes.title: the Ember Queen
heroes.bio: Queen of the Ninth Furnace. She lost the war, kept the crown, and has decided the war is not over.
heroes.look: Voluptuous nightclub empress: huge curled chrome ram horns with a rhinestone crown, long wavy black hair with crimson ends. Candy-red metallic micro bikini with chrome O-rings, chrome chain belt, red latex thigh-high platform boots, and a floor-length black vinyl coat worn off the shoulders with a huge fur collar; cyber-sigil tattoos. A chrome greatsword with a painted flame edge on her shoulder, hand on hip; bat wings, spaded tail; a commanding smirk.

ultimate.name: Ninth Furnace
ultimate.description: Brings down the burning greatsword: 320% ATK to her target, 140% ATK to every other enemy, and Burns them all (50% ATK per second) for 4 s. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Queen's Wrath
passives.description: +15% ATK and +10% crit chance.

passives.name: Unending War
passives.description: On kill: restores 20% of her max HP and gains 300 energy.

legend.title: Crown of Cinders

passive.name: Crown of Cinders
passive.description: +25% ATK and +15% crit chance. Basic attacks Burn the target (40% ATK per second) for 3 s. Heals for 15% of damage dealt.

ult_bonus.name: Ninth Furnace: Unbanked
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also cuts every enemy's DEF by 30% for 6 s and gives her +30% ATK for 6 s.

lore: The crown was forged from the surrender treaty. She wears the signatures on the inside.
Eight furnaces went out when the war ended. The ninth is waiting for her to say the word.
She has drafted the victory speech. It is one line long, and it is a name.

heroes.name: Brakka
heroes.title: Brimstone Bulwark
heroes.bio: Undefeated in the Pit Arena, bouncer at the Brimstone club, and the only demon who hugs harder than she hits. Loyal to Mordessa, and to anyone who brings snacks.
heroes.look: Towering red-skinned bodybuilder demon, champion of hell's arena and bouncer at its club: glossy black micro bikini top with a chrome O-ring, black vinyl thong-cut bottom, a huge chrome-and-gold championship belt, chain chest harness, hot-rod engine gauntlets with exhaust pipes, black platform boots with flame decals. Bleached spiked hair with frosted tips, big chrome bull horns, small tusks, cyber-sigil tattoos, a thick tail. Double-biceps flex and a huge friendly grin.

ultimate.name: Magma Bulwark
ultimate.description: Plants her molten gauntlets: gains a shield of 40% max HP and Taunts all enemies for 5 s.

passives.name: Molten Hide
passives.description: Reflects 20% of damage taken back to the attacker.

heroes.name: Vesper
heroes.title: Mistress of Ember Rain
heroes.bio: A succubus scholar who reads the future in falling ash. Her forecasts are always right, and always fire.
heroes.look: Sultry hourglass hacker succubus: long straight wine-red hair, half-lidded eyes behind red-tinted rimless glasses, small glossy horns. Glossy crimson latex catsuit with a heart-shaped cleavage window, an underboob cutout and hip windows, black latex opera gloves, a high-collared open black vinyl cape lined in hot pink. A red glass hellfire orb ringed by chrome rings in one raised hand, adjusting her glasses with the other; bat wings, heart-spaded tail.

ultimate.name: Ember Rain
ultimate.description: Forecast: fire. 140% ATK to all enemies and Burns them (50% ATK per second) for 6 s. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Ashen Forecast
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 35% chance to Burn the target (30% ATK per second) for 3 s.

heroes.name: Imra
heroes.title: Lantern of Pacts
heroes.bio: An imp shaman who brokers small, fair deals. Mostly fair. Fair-ish.
heroes.look: Lithe, toned adult fire dancer with glam makeup: crimson metallic bandeau bikini, chrome body jewelry (waist chain, arm cuffs, navel ring), UV cyber-sigil body paint, chrome gladiator platform sandals. A shoulder-length orange mane, large curved horns, pointed ears. Raises a lantern staff topped with a chrome-capped lava lamp; bat wings, curly tail; a sultry smirk.

ultimate.name: Lantern Pact
ultimate.description: Strikes a deal with the whole team: all allies +20% ATK for 5 s, and every other ally gains 100 energy. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Fair-ish Deal
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 50% chance to Weaken the target: -15% ATK for 3 s.

passives.name: Lantern Light
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain 150 energy.

heroes.name: Kessa
heroes.title: Ashen Claw
heroes.bio: A hellcat bounty hunter. Twelve contracts, twelve trophies, and one very full scrapbook.
heroes.look: Athletic, curvy cat burglar: black latex catsuit zipped open below the cleavage, a red chrome-ringed harness, thong-cut with hip windows, a long red vinyl scarf, black platform thigh boots. Chrome cat-ear headphones over short choppy black hair with a red streak, a red cat-eye visor pushed up, small horns, amber slit-pupil eyes, a smug smile. Twin black-chrome crescent sickles in a low, hip-cocked stance; a long cat tail.

ultimate.name: Twelfth Contract
ultimate.description: Pounces on the weakest enemy anywhere: 280% ATK, executing it if left below 25% HP (not bosses). Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Hunter's Instinct
passives.description: +25% damage to enemies below 50% HP.

passives.name: Nine Lives
passives.description: Heals for 20% of damage dealt.

heroes.name: Drezza
heroes.title: the Headliner
heroes.bio: She has headlined the Brimstone club every night for six hundred years and never played the same set twice. When she drops the beat the whole team moves faster; when she stops, nobody wants to go home.
heroes.look: Tall, lithe cyber-goth DJ with light brown skin: a black latex micro top under hot-pink criss-cross harness straps with chrome O-rings, a hot-pink PVC highleg thong bottom on O-ring hip straps, a bare midriff, fluffy black-and-pink faux-fur leg warmers over chunky platform boots. One huge high ponytail of hot-pink and black synthetic hair falls, cyber goggles on her forehead, rhinestone face gems, glossy chrome horns, a chrome-tipped spaded tail. A chrome DJ deck slung at her hip, one hand pressing a headphone cup to her ear, the other raising a red vinyl record; a mid-beat grin.

ultimate.name: Bass Drop
ultimate.description: Drops the beat: all allies gain +20% ATK and +15% SPD for 5 s, and every other ally gains 100 energy. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Warm-Up Set
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain 150 energy.

passives.name: Sold Out
passives.description: Battle start: all allies gain +8% ATK and +5% max HP.

legend.title: Encore of the Abyss

passive.name: Encore
passive.description: +20% HP and +10% DEF. Battle start: all allies gain +12% ATK, +8% max HP and 200 energy.

ult_bonus.name: Bass Drop: Afterparty
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also shields all allies for 12% of her max HP and gives them +20% DEF for 5 s.

lore: Her first set lasted forty years. The crowd only noticed when the walls had started to dance.
There is a track she has never released. Demons who hear the demo stop being afraid.
The last song of the world is already booked. She is closing.

heroes.name: Zecchina
heroes.title: House Edge
heroes.bio: She runs the tables at hell's grand casino and has never once let the house lose. She remembers every debt in the underworld, and she always collects.
heroes.look: Statuesque, voluptuous casino queen: a rhinestone-crusted black tuxedo tailcoat worn open with long tails over a black latex underbust corset and a red latex micro bandeau, a black latex highleg thong bottom, black latex opera gloves, fishnet thigh-highs on garters, red patent stilettos, a chrome bow-tie collar and gold-chrome casino chips in her garter. Glossy champagne-blonde Hollywood waves, long straight black horns with gold-chrome tips, small bat wings, a long spaded tail. Fans razor-edged chrome cards beside her face, hand on her hip; a half-lidded, knowing smile.

ultimate.name: Full House
ultimate.description: Deals the whole table in: 100% ATK to all enemies, then 200% ATK to the weakest enemy, executing it if left below 25% HP (not bosses). Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Card Counter
passives.description: +25% damage to enemies below 50% HP and +10% crit chance.

passives.name: Collect the Debt
passives.description: On kill: gains 400 energy. Heals for 10% of damage dealt.

legend.title: The House Always Wins

passive.name: All In
passive.description: +30% damage to enemies below 50% HP, +20% crit chance and +50% crit damage. On kill: gains 500 energy.

ult_bonus.name: Full House: Double Down
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also hits the weakest enemy for another 250% ATK, executing it below 30% HP (not bosses), and gives her +30% SPD for 5 s.

lore: She has never shuffled a deck. The cards simply arrive in the order she prefers.
Hell's treasury owes her money. So does heaven's. Neither has worked out how.
Her last chip is engraved with your name. She is only waiting for the right table.

heroes.name: Torqua
heroes.title: Grid Queen
heroes.bio: The face of hell's grand prix, and the reason nobody storms the pit lane twice. A thousand photo calls taught her to hold a smile, a parasol and a line.
heroes.look: Towering race-queen glamazon with deep brown skin: a glossy candy-red and white PVC race-queen bodysuit, extreme highleg and thong-cut, plunging to the navel with both sides cut open, a cropped matching bolero with checkered trim and sigil decals, red latex thigh-high platform boots, chrome hoop earrings. Long, voluminous candy-red blowout curls, swept-back chrome horns, a long tail. A chrome-and-red race parasol held up high, the other hand on her cocked hip; a dazzling camera smile.

ultimate.name: Red Flag
ultimate.description: Waves the red flag: gains a shield of 30% max HP, Taunts all enemies for 5 s and Weakens them all (-15% ATK) for 5 s. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Pit Wall
passives.description: Takes 10% less damage and gains +10% HP.

passives.name: Pole Position
passives.description: Battle start: gains a shield equal to 20% of her max HP. Reflects 10% of damage taken back to the attacker.

heroes.name: Sigilla
heroes.title: Burning Ink
heroes.bio: Hers is the only parlor in hell where demons queue politely, because every curse she inks comes true. Her rates are reasonable; her waiting list is not.
heroes.look: Soft, thick tattoo artist inked from collarbone to ankle in black and red cyber-sigil tattoos: a red latex micro string bikini with a highleg thong bottom, a cropped black vinyl shrug with flash-sheet decals, a chrome studded garter belt, black platform creepers. Long black curls over a cherry-red underlayer, one side shaved, small curled horns pierced with chrome rings, chrome lip and brow piercings, bat wings tattooed with flash art, a spaded tail. Aims an oversized chrome tattoo machine on a coiled red cord like a pistol, the other hand on her hip; a lazy, smoldering look.

ultimate.name: Permanent Ink
ultimate.description: Inks a curse on every enemy: -20% DEF for 6 s, then 140% ATK to all of them and Burns them (50% ATK per second) for 6 s. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Flash Sheet
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 40% chance to Expose the target: -15% DEF for 3 s.

passives.name: Fresh Ink
passives.description: +16% ATK and +10% crit chance.

heroes.name: Carmesa
heroes.title: Red Veronica
heroes.bio: Born with a bull's horns and a matador's nerve, she settled the argument by becoming both. She bows before every kill, and she has never missed her moment.
heroes.look: Dancer-built matador with olive skin: a cropped rhinestone-crusted red-and-chrome bolero with epaulettes open over a black latex bandeau cut to show underboob, black latex high-waisted thong-back micro shorts with rhinestone side stripes, hot-pink latex thigh-high stockings, black patent pumps with chrome buckles. Deep burgundy hair in a slick low chignon, glossy black forward-curving bull horns, a long tail. A red vinyl capote swept out in one hand, a chrome estoc pointed down in the other, chin up and back arched; a cool, theatrical look.

ultimate.name: Moment of Truth
ultimate.description: Passes the cape over the front row, Weakening it (-30% ATK) for 5 s, then thrusts twice at the weakest back-row enemy for 180% ATK each. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Cape Work
passives.description: +12% SPD and +10% crit chance.

passives.name: Final Bow
passives.description: On kill: restores 15% of her max HP and gains 300 energy.

heroes.name: Thrasha
heroes.title: Power Chord
heroes.bio: Her band is banned from every venue in hell, so now she plays the battlefield. Loud, reckless and secretly sentimental: she still answers all her fan mail.
heroes.look: Lean, wiry nu-metal rocker: a black vinyl micro bikini top held together with chrome safety pins and chains, a black PVC highleg thong bottom, torn black fishnet thigh-highs, a cropped studded black vinyl biker jacket slipping off her shoulders, chrome wallet chains, a spiked choker, black platform combat boots. A choppy hot-pink wolf cut, smudged black eyeliner and black lipstick, one horn broken off and capped in chrome, tattered bat wings. A chrome flying-V guitar-axe held by the neck over her shoulder, the other hand throwing the horns; a snarling grin.

ultimate.name: Encore Smash
ultimate.description: Swings the guitar-axe three times at her target for 130% ATK each, then gains +25% ATK for 5 s. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Mosh Pit
passives.description: +12% ATK and +8% HP.

passives.name: Feedback
passives.description: +20% crit damage. Heals for 15% of damage dealt.

heroes.name: Kindra
heroes.title: Fire Marshal
heroes.bio: Hell's fire marshal: her job is keeping every fire burning exactly where it should. She has carried more demons out of collapsing clubs than anyone, and has a terrible pun for each of them.
heroes.look: Muscular, tan fire marshal with soot smudges: a red latex micro bandeau under red suspenders, a black highleg thong-cut bottom with chrome reflective stripes, black thigh-high turnout boots, a cropped turnout jacket over her shoulders, a glossy red-and-chrome fire helmet with her stubby charred horns through it. Short ash-blonde hair shaved at the sides, a thick tail. A chrome fire axe held low, her thumb hooked in a suspender and pulling it out, chest out; a big confident wink.

ultimate.name: Backdraft
ultimate.description: Kicks the door in: 120% ATK to front-row enemies and Burns them (40% ATK per second) for 5 s, then gains a shield of 20% max HP and Taunts all enemies for 4 s. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Fireproof
passives.description: Takes 10% less damage and gains +10% DEF.

passives.name: Hot Zone
passives.description: Reflects 15% of damage taken back to the attacker and gains +15% HP.

heroes.name: Cordia
heroes.title: Last Call
heroes.bio: She tended bar at the Brimstone club before the club was built. She knows what you need before you ask, and she never repeats what you told her.
heroes.look: Hourglass bartender: a black latex waistcoat with nothing under it, buttoned once at the waist and plunging to the navel, a red latex bow-tie collar on bare skin, red latex cuffs, a black latex pencil micro skirt slit to the hip, black patent platform heels, a garter holster of tiny chrome flasks. Voluminous auburn curls swept to one side, elegant ram horns banded in chrome, small bat wings, a spaded tail. Shakes a chrome cocktail shaker up by her shoulder, the other hand on her hip; a warm, knowing smirk.

ultimate.name: One for the Road
ultimate.description: Pours a round for the team: heals all allies for 180% ATK and grants them +15% ATK for 5 s. Charms her target for 2.5 s: it turns on its own side.

passives.name: Strong Pour
passives.description: Healing done +20% and +8% ATK.

passives.name: Liquid Courage
passives.description: Her ultimate also gives every other ally 100 energy.

heroes.name: Noctaire
heroes.title: Eclipse Reaper
heroes.bio: Once Heaven's executioner, she cut her own wings rather than carry out one final order. She still keeps the blade.
heroes.look: Tall, slender glitch reaper: black latex sling leotard open at the sides, highleg, a long oil-slick holographic drape from chrome hip buckles, black latex opera gloves, heeled thigh boots. Long silver hair, cold violet eyes, a cracked chrome halo with pixel gaps, tattered black wings with pixel-block tips. A huge oil-slick chrome scythe with a violet edge, her free hand sweeping back her hair; melancholic allure.

ultimate.name: Eclipse Harvest
ultimate.description: Dives into the back row with her crescent scythe: 220% ATK to every back-row enemy, executing any left below 30% HP (not bosses).

passives.name: Severed Wings
passives.description: +15% crit chance and +10% SPD.

passives.name: Last Order
passives.description: On kill: gains 500 energy.

legend.title: Midnight Absolute

passive.name: Total Eclipse
passive.description: +20% crit chance, +15% SPD and +50% crit damage. On kill: restores 15% of her max HP and gains 400 energy.

ult_bonus.name: Eclipse Harvest: Umbra
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also strikes every front-row enemy for 150% ATK and Stuns the back row for 1.5 s.

lore: The order she refused had one name on it. She still has the envelope, unopened.
Her wings were never burned. She buried them in a place only the moon can find.
Heaven sent nine reapers after her. She sent back nine scythes, sharpened.

heroes.name: Orrin
heroes.title: the Chained Oath
heroes.bio: She guarded the gate of a heaven that crashed. The gate is gone; the firewall isn't. Now she stands between her friends and everything else.
heroes.look: Tall, scarred guardian of a crashed heaven: glossy black vinyl monokini, highleg, with a chrome O-ring cutout at the sternum and cutouts at the waist, one heavy chrome pauldron, chrome gauntlets, smoked-acrylic thigh greaves, violet fiber-optic cables wrapped around her. A tall frosted smoked-acrylic riot shield with a broken loading-ring sigil. Long straight silver hair with a black underlayer, a scar through one eye, a cracked chrome halo at her hip, black wings with chrome tips; stoic.

ultimate.name: Chains of the Oath
ultimate.description: Lashes out with broken chains: 130% ATK to front-row enemies and Stuns them for 2.5 s, then Weakens all enemies (-25% ATK) for 6 s.

passives.name: Oathbound
passives.description: Takes 12% less damage.

passives.name: Guarding Chains
passives.description: +20% DEF and +15% HP.

heroes.name: Sable
heroes.title: Censer of Dusk
heroes.bio: A fallen nun who still holds services in ruined chapels. Her congregation is mostly ghosts. They come every week.
heroes.look: Curvy cyber nun: skin-tight black latex habit-bodysuit with a plunging keyhole cutout, corset lacing and chrome trim, thong-cut, long black vinyl tabard panels open at the hips, black latex thighhighs on garters, platform heels. An opaque black coif under a holographic veil, dark-teal hair, a chrome cross. Swings a chrome censer orb; grey wings with an oil-slick sheen, a dim cracked halo; a gentle, sad smile.

ultimate.name: Dusk Requiem
ultimate.description: Swings the censer for the lost: all enemies -50% DEF for 8 s, and all allies heal for 200% ATK.

passives.name: Censer Smoke
passives.description: Basic attacks Expose the target: -25% DEF for 3 s.

passives.name: Vespers
passives.description: Each basic attack also heals the most wounded ally for 70% ATK.

heroes.name: Lucen
heroes.title: Splitwing
heroes.bio: Half of her fell. She styled the other half to match. She swears she hasn't picked a side; her rapier picks for her.
heroes.look: Slender duelist split down the middle: hair white on one side and black on the other, an asymmetric glossy white-and-black vinyl bodysuit cut diagonally (underboob on one side, sideboob on the other), thong-cut, one long sleeve; one white thigh-high platform boot and one bare leg with a garter ring; tinted oval sunglasses in her hair. One white pearl wing, one black chrome wing, no halo. Points a chrome rapier at the viewer, hip cocked, with a wink.

ultimate.name: Twinfeather Flurry
ultimate.description: A dazzling flurry: 5 strikes of 85% ATK at random enemies, then +25% SPD for 5 s.

passives.name: Neither Side
passives.description: +10% ATK and +10% HP.

passives.name: Flourish
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to strike twice.

heroes.name: Ashra
heroes.title: Witch of Ash
heroes.bio: She burned her own heaven down by accident. Now she studies fire very, very carefully.
heroes.look: Sleepy vaporwave witch: an oversized holographic violet witch hat with chrome star pins, glossy violet robes slipping off her shoulders over a micro black tube top showing underboob and black micro shorts, a chrome chain belt, chunky silver headphones around her neck, platform ankle boots. Messy grey hair with violet streaks, a cracked chrome halo, small grey wings. One arm lazily raised, a chrome star wand in the other hand.

ultimate.name: Accidental Inferno
ultimate.description: Oops. 180% ATK to all enemies, +60% damage to enemies below 50% HP.

passives.name: Ash Cloud
passives.description: Her ultimate also Weakens all enemies: -15% ATK for 4 s.

heroes.name: Nadira
heroes.title: Lost Signal
heroes.bio: Heaven's satellite keeper until the signal died and she fell with it, still strapped in. She can still call the dead ones down, and they always answer.
heroes.look: Tall, long-limbed satellite keeper with dark umber skin: a glossy black-and-violet space suit cut into a highleg bodysuit zipped open to the navel and open at both sides, oil-slick holographic panels, chrome mission patches with a broken loading-ring logo, chunky white-and-chrome platform moon boots. A mirrored chrome space helmet tucked under one arm on her hip; the other hand raises a staff topped with a small broken chrome satellite. Long silver-white locs tied loosely back, black wings with chrome solar-panel feathers spread wide, a cracked chrome halo tilted like a planet's ring; a calm, distant look.

ultimate.name: Deorbit
ultimate.description: Calls down a dead satellite: 220% ATK to all enemies and Stuns the back row for 1.5 s.

passives.name: Lost Transmission
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to Weaken the target: -20% ATK for 3 s. Battle start: gains 300 energy.

legend.title: Signal Restored

passive.name: Carrier Wave
passive.description: +25% ATK and +10% SPD. Battle start: gains 500 energy. Basic attacks have a 35% chance to Stun the target for 1 s.

ult_bonus.name: Deorbit: Full Constellation
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also Burns every enemy (60% ATK per second) for 4 s and cuts their DEF by 25% for 6 s.

lore: The last transmission before the fall was her call sign, repeated. Nobody answered it.
Three hundred dead satellites still turn to face her when she looks up.
One of them is not dead. It has been waiting for her signal to come back.

heroes.name: Gantra
heroes.title: Last Pilot
heroes.bio: She piloted the last mech of heaven's crashed fleet and walked out of the wreck carrying its arm. She still talks to it; it is the better listener.
heroes.look: Tall, athletic, curvy mech pilot: a glossy black-and-teal pilot bodysuit unzipped from the collar to the navel over opaque cups, cut highleg with open sides, a chrome pilot collar, chrome interface nodes on her hips and spine, teal painted seams, black platform pilot boots. Her mech's giant torn-off chrome forearm is strapped over her left arm and raised like a tower shield, huge fingers spread, a cracked chrome halo bolted to its shoulder; her free hand rests on her hip. Short choppy teal hair over a shaved undercut, a cracked pilot headset, no wings; a tired, cocky half-smile.

ultimate.name: Final Sortie
ultimate.description: One last launch: shields all allies for 12% of her max HP, slams front-row enemies for 120% ATK and Stuns them for 1.5 s.

passives.name: Armored Frame
passives.description: Takes 15% less damage.

passives.name: Full Sync
passives.description: Reflects 20% of damage taken back to the attacker. Her ultimate also Taunts all enemies for 4 s.

legend.title: Unbroken Frame

passive.name: Unbroken Frame
passive.description: +30% HP and +25% DEF. Takes 20% less damage. Battle start: shields herself for 30% of her max HP.

ult_bonus.name: Final Sortie: Full Burn
ult_bonus.description: Her ultimate also shields all allies for another 10% of her max HP and gives them +25% DEF for 6 s.

lore: The mech's black box recorded her last order: hold the line. She is still holding it.
The arm she carries has started to answer back. It agrees with everything she says.
Somewhere in the wreck the rest of the fleet is waiting. She means to fly it home.

heroes.name: Severine
heroes.title: Masterless Blade
heroes.bio: Sworn to an archangel who fell first, she has served no one since. She is quietest when she is amused, and that is when you should run.
heroes.look: Athletic cyber-ronin: a black latex chest wrap under a short black latex kimono jacket worn off both shoulders, pixel-glitch patterns on its sleeves, a wide oil-slick holographic obi corset belt, a highleg black latex bottom under long black vinyl panels split to the hip on both sides, black latex thigh-highs and black platform sandals. She draws a long chrome odachi with a violet painted edge from the black scabbard at her hip, low and ready. Very long straight black hair in a high ponytail bound by a chrome ring, long tattered black wings, a cracked chrome halo with a piece missing; a faint, dangerous smile.

ultimate.name: Masterless Cut
ultimate.description: One draw through the front line: 240% ATK to every front-row enemy, +50% damage to enemies below 50% HP.

passives.name: Clean Cut
passives.description: +15% crit chance. On kill: gains 300 energy.

heroes.name: Benthe
heroes.title: Crush Depth
heroes.bio: She fell into the sea, kept falling to the bottom, and decided she liked it there. She surfaces only when her friends need a wall, and she is a very good wall.
heroes.look: Towering, powerful deep-sea guardian with pale blue-grey skin: a black latex high-neck swimsuit with a huge keyhole cutout from the collar to the navel and an open back, highleg, under a bolted chrome diving corselet that yokes only her shoulders; oil-slick barnacle rivets, a chrome weight belt across her hips, chunky chrome diving boots. A huge chrome anchor stands upright beside her like a tower shield, one hand on its fluke, the heavy chain looped over her shoulder. Long deep-teal wet-look waves, heavy black wings with chrome rivet tips folded tight, a cracked chrome halo; a slow, sleepy smile.

ultimate.name: Anchor Drop
ultimate.description: Drops anchor on her target: 150% ATK and Stuns it for 3 s, then all allies gain +25% DEF for 5 s and a shield of 8% of her max HP.

passives.name: Abyssal Calm
passives.description: Takes 10% less damage and gains +15% DEF.

heroes.name: Seyra
heroes.title: Static Oracle
heroes.bio: She reads the future in dead television static and has never been wrong, except about her own fall. She already knows what you are about to say.
heroes.look: Soft, curvy oracle: a black latex halter bodysuit split by a narrow plunge from the collar to below the navel over opaque cups, highleg, with a bare back, under a long violet vinyl priestess drape with CRT scan-line patterns that hangs from a chrome collar, open at the front and sides; black platform sandals. She cradles a cracked chrome-framed crystal ball full of TV static beneath her chest, head tilted as if listening. Long straight periwinkle hair with blunt bangs, a chrome third-eye diadem with a teal gem, grey wings with oil-slick eye spots spread low, a cracked chrome halo with a pixel gap; a dreamy smile.

ultimate.name: Foreseen
ultimate.description: She saw this coming: heals all allies for 160% ATK, shields them for 10% of her max HP, and Weakens all enemies (-20% ATK) for 4 s.

passives.name: Second Sight
passives.description: +15% HP and healing done +15%.

passives.name: Static Hymn
passives.description: Her ultimate also grants all allies +20% DEF for 5 s.

heroes.name: Rivette
heroes.title: Hard Stop
heroes.bio: She skates the broken highways of the Fallen wastes, and everything on them stops for her. First to the finish line, first to buy the rounds.
heroes.look: Athletic, powerful roller-derby jammer: a black-and-violet vinyl underboob crop top laced up the front, violet PVC highleg micro briefs, black latex thigh-highs with chrome garter rings, chrome knee and elbow pads, platform roller skates with violet wheels. A bent chrome stop sign welded onto a pole as a poleaxe, planted beside her with one arm hooked over it, hip cocked. A platinum buzz cut with violet tips, clipped black wings with chrome tips, a cracked chrome halo tilted on her head; a cocky grin.

ultimate.name: Red Light
ultimate.description: Everything stops: 260% ATK to her target and Stuns it for 1.5 s, then she gains +20% SPD for 5 s.

passives.name: Lead Jammer
passives.description: +12% SPD and +8% ATK.

passives.name: Power Jam
passives.description: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to strike twice. +20% crit damage.

heroes.name: Vandra
heroes.title: Wet Paint
heroes.bio: She tags the ruins of fallen heaven with spells instead of signatures, and whatever she paints starts to burn. Authority is just a wall she hasn't got to yet.
heroes.look: Lithe, curvy street artist: an oversized black vinyl hoodie cropped just under the breasts, hood down and covered in wildstyle tags, a teal latex highleg micro bikini bottom with paint-splattered straps, paint-flecked teal latex thigh-highs, chunky platform sneakers, a paint-flecked respirator pulled down around her neck. One oil-slick chrome spray can raised at shoulder height as if tagging the air, the other at her hip. A messy teal-and-violet shag flecked with paint, black wings tagged in teal and violet graffiti, a cracked chrome halo with a painted drip; a mischievous smile.

ultimate.name: Wildstyle
ultimate.description: Tags the whole enemy line: 120% ATK to all enemies and Exposes them (-25% DEF) for 5 s.

passives.name: Drip
passives.description: Her ultimate also Burns all enemies (40% ATK per second) for 4 s.

heroes.name: Ombre
heroes.title: Dead Pixel
heroes.bio: One shot per battle, and she has never needed a second. She reads novels between targets and always finishes the chapter.
heroes.look: Long, lean cyber-noir sniper: a black latex micro bandeau and highleg briefs under a chrome-buckled tactical chest harness, thigh holsters and black latex arm sleeves, a long black-to-silver ombre vinyl trench coat worn open off her shoulders, knee-high platform combat boots. A long chrome sniper rifle with a pixel-crosshair scope held diagonally at low ready; her free hand lowers tiny oval chrome sunglasses so she can look over them. Very long black hair fading to silver in a low ponytail, long black wings fading to silver at the tips, a cracked chrome halo shaped like a scope reticle; a cool, deadpan stare.

ultimate.name: One Shot
ultimate.description: One round, one name: 380% ATK to the weakest back-row enemy, executing it if left below 25% HP (not bosses).

passives.name: Steady Aim
passives.description: +20% crit chance.

passives.name: Overwatch
passives.description: +35% crit damage and +10% ATK.
